items.label: Profile
items.content: Product leader who owns digital products end to end, from discovery and requirements through UX, cross-functional delivery, and measurement. Currently leads product delivery for institutional clients including the City of Calgary and NAIT, acting as the primary liaison between stakeholders and design and engineering teams. A background building and marketing advanced technology products.

jobs.title: Fractional Head of Product & Development
bullets: Act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and cross-functional engineering teams, leading digital products from discovery through launch for institutional clients.
Run product discovery and user testing to prioritize the right problems, then translate customer needs into scoped project plans, acceptance criteria, and a development roadmaps.
Own the full product lifecycle: scoping, risk management and client-facing communication across all active projects, working in iterative build cycles.
Built ELIXR's product and delivery function from scratch, establishing the SOPs, project-management systems, and intake process the team uses to scope new digital experiences.

Ran usability testing and iteration, and led client training and handoff.

Used pilot performance data to guide product and UX decisions ahead of a wider release.

Rebuilt attribution and reporting to drive data-informed decisions, cutting tracked acquisition cost from $72 to $22.

header.name: Brayden Clark
header.title: Digital Product Lead · Discovery to Delivery · Customer Experience

body: I'm applying for the Product Owner role on your Innovation & IT Services team. I lead digital products end to end for institutional clients: I sit between stakeholders and the build team, turn what customers actually need into prioritized, testable features, and own them through delivery. That is the core of this role, pointed at the experience of UFA's mobile app and MyUFA platform.

My product background is hands-on and zero-to-one rather than years spent maintaining a single platform, which makes me quick to spot friction and act on it. I've owned the full lifecycle for clients including the City of Calgary and NAIT, shipped a phone-based app from design through launch, and I judge changes by whether the data moves: a recent pilot reached 73.5% utilization, a 4.84 out of 5 satisfaction score, and an NPS of 84. A growth-marketing background means I instrument and measure everything, and I'm at home in agile delivery alongside design, engineering, and QA.

What draws me to UFA is that the mandate is member experience, not just software. As a Calgarian I know the co-operative and the communities it serves, and I'd bring a builder's bias for shipping and measuring improvements to every digital touchpoint your 127,000-plus members rely on. Thank you for considering my application.
